zh: 今天天气不错，我们去公园走走吧。
en: The weather is nice today. Let's take a walk in the park.

zh: 这家餐厅的招牌菜是红烧肉。
en: The signature dish at this restaurant is braised pork.

zh: 记得提前十分钟到会议室。
en: Remember to arrive at the meeting room ten minutes early.

zh: 外面下大雨了，出门记得带把伞，路上小心。
en: It's pouring outside. Take an umbrella and be careful on your way.

zh: 早上七点起床跑步，坚持一个月感觉精神好多了。
en: I get up at seven to go running, and after a month I feel much more energetic.

zh: 冰箱空了，下班路上顺便去超市买点菜。
en: The fridge is empty; I'll pick up some groceries at the supermarket on my way home.

zh: 这件外套打完折才两百块，比网上买还划算。
en: With the discount, this jacket costs just two hundred yuan, even cheaper than online.

zh: 邻居家装修吵了两个星期，今天终于结束了。
en: The neighbor's renovation noise finally ended today after two weeks.

zh: 周末全家去郊外爬山，孩子们玩得特别开心。
en: The whole family went hiking in the hills over the weekend, and the kids had a great time.

zh: 医生建议少熬夜，每天保证七个小时的睡眠。
en: The doctor advised me to stop staying up late and get seven hours of sleep a day.

zh: 晚高峰地铁太挤了，我宁愿骑车回家。
en: The subway is too crowded at rush hour, so I'd rather bike home.

zh: 妈妈包的饺子是全世界最好吃的，没有之一。
en: My mom's dumplings are the best in the world, no contest.

zh: 手机没电了，借你的充电器用一下好吗？
en: My phone is out of battery. Could I borrow your charger for a minute?

zh: 新开的菜市场就在小区门口，走路五分钟就到。
en: The new food market is right at the entrance of our neighborhood, a five-minute walk away.

zh: 天气预报说明天降温十度，记得给孩子加衣服。
en: The forecast says temperatures will drop by ten degrees tomorrow, so dress the kids warmly.

zh: 我把快递放在物业了，回来的时候记得取一下。
en: I left the package with the property office; remember to pick it up when you're back.

zh: 这条街晚上很热闹，夜市摊子一直开到半夜。
en: This street gets lively at night, with night-market stalls open until midnight.

zh: 搬家那天多亏邻居们帮忙，我请他们吃了顿饭。
en: The neighbors helped a lot on moving day, so I treated them to dinner.

zh: 每天睡前刷两小时手机，第二天眼睛总是很干。
en: After two hours on my phone before bed, my eyes always feel dry the next day.

zh: 公交卡充值可以在手机上完成，不用再跑服务网点。
en: You can top up your transit card in an app now; there's no need to visit a service counter.
